text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The Slovak Economics Ministry, at present, manages 61 state companies, of which in 30 cases authorities have already approved either privatisation decisions or liquidation procedures.

- Deputy Economic Minister Jozef Brhel considers the current Slovak trade deficit as a usual development in transforming economies, saying that the major part of the shortfall was due to imports of technological goods necessary for restructuring the economy.
- All major Slovak newspapers will increase their prices by an average of 16 percent from the beginning of next year.
- The opposition Democratic Party (DS) accused the governing coalition of corrupting the state administration and stealing state property during the privatisation process.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - One of the major Slovak breweries, Karsay s.r.o., said its production totalled 424,373 hectolitres of beer this year. The brewery plans to increase its production to 500,000 hectolitres in 1997.
